user.title: Add gateway
user.description: Which gateway do you want to add?

serial.title: USB connection
serial.description: Choose the serial port of the {model}.

data_description.path: Prefer the /dev/serial/by-id path, it survives reboots and re-plugging.

tcp.title: Network connection (ser2net)
tcp.description: Host and port of the ser2net server the {model} is connected to. The baud rate is set in ser2net, not here: {baudrate} baud for this gateway.

base_id.title: Base ID
base_id.description: The {model} did not report its base ID. Enter it (for example FF-AA-80-00); it is printed on the device or shown by PCT14. For the FAM14 it is read from its memory later, with the bus import.

bus_group.title: Bus
bus_group.description: Is this gateway on the same RS485 bus as an existing one? Gateways on the same bus form a bus group: commands for bus actors fail over between them.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Gateway found
zeroconf_confirm.description: A {model} was found at {connection}. Add it?

error.cannot_connect: Cannot open the connection. Check the port, host and baud rate.
error.invalid_base_id: Not a valid base ID. It lies between FF-80-00-00 and FF-FF-FF-80 and ends in 00 or 80.

abort.already_configured: A gateway with this base ID is already set up.

options.rocker_contact: Contact via rocker telegrams (FTS14EM, garage door …)
options.heating_actuator: Heating actuator, Home Assistant controls (FHK14, FAE14 …)

cover_position_unknown.message: The position is unknown; open or close the cover fully first.

room_controller_read_only.message: This room controller is operated on site; its setpoint cannot be changed from Home Assistant.

capture.name: Capture telegrams
capture.description: Records all telegrams for a while and writes them as JSONL to /config/enocean_eltako/. The files can be used as test fixtures.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: Only telegrams of this gateway; empty for all.

data_description.message_delay: Minimum time between two telegrams sent by this gateway.
data_description.mode: On demand: connected only when the bus group needs this gateway (failover, import), so PCT14 can use it in between.

device.title: Device
device.description: Examples: {examples}. Receives {receive}; senders: {send}. The first sender ID is suggested from this gateway's pool; further senders are optional (leave empty). Teach each one in with its button.

data.name: Name
data.status_request: Ask for the state at startup

data_description.device_id: ID of the device's telegrams, for example 05-10-A2-B3 (actuators: the ID of their status telegrams).
data_description.time_opens: Full travel time from closed to open.
data_description.time_closes: Full travel time from open to closed.
data_description.routing: Which sender moves the cover. Positions always use the controller when it is set.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Sensor whose temperature is sent to the actuator (any temperature sensor in Home Assistant).
data_description.send_interval: How often setpoint and temperature are sent. The actuator needs a telegram at least every 10 min, otherwise it goes into fault mode after 1 h.
data_description.unavailable_when_silent: Show the entities as unavailable when the device was not heard for three times its usual interval.
data_description.status_request: Only for actuators that answer a confirmation request (FL62, FR62, FD62). Others keep their last state, marked as assumed, until they report.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure device
reconfigure.description: Examples: {examples}. Receives {receive}; senders: {send}. The first sender ID is suggested from this gateway's pool; further senders are optional (leave empty). Teach each one in with its button.

data.name: Name
data.status_request: Ask for the state at startup

data_description.time_opens: Full travel time from closed to open.
data_description.time_closes: Full travel time from open to closed.
data_description.routing: Which sender moves the cover. Positions always use the controller when it is set.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Sensor whose temperature is sent to the actuator (any temperature sensor in Home Assistant).
data_description.send_interval: How often setpoint and temperature are sent. The actuator needs a telegram at least every 10 min, otherwise it goes into fault mode after 1 h.
data_description.unavailable_when_silent: Show the entities as unavailable when the device was not heard for three times its usual interval.
data_description.status_request: Only for actuators that answer a confirmation request (FL62, FR62, FD62). Others keep their last state, marked as assumed, until they report.

address.title: Device ID
address.description: Listen for a telegram (press a button on the device, or switch the actuator locally) or enter the ID.

learn_timeout.title: Nothing received
learn_timeout.description: No telegram from a new sender arrived. Try again or enter the ID.

error.already_configured: This device ID is already set up on this gateway.
error.sender_blocked: Blocked until the teach-out of the removed device is confirmed.

abort.gateway_not_loaded: The gateway is not loaded. Devices can be added once it is connected.

progress.learn: Waiting up to {seconds} s for a telegram. Press a button on the device or switch the actuator locally now.

climate_silent.title: {name} has not been controlled for 45 minutes
climate_silent.description: Home Assistant could not send setpoint and temperature to {name} for 45 minutes (gateway offline?). After 1 hour without a telegram the heating actuator switches to its fault mode with a fixed heating cycle.

device_silent.title: {name} not heard for {hours} h
device_silent.description: {name} usually reports regularly but has not been heard for {hours} hours. Last received by: {gateway}. Check its battery or power supply and the radio range.

gateway_disconnected.title: {name} is disconnected
gateway_disconnected.description: The connection to {name} ({connection}) has been down for more than 5 minutes; Home Assistant keeps retrying. Check the USB cable or the ser2net service and the network.
